newsitem.title: CANADA: Ottawa to cut red tape for small business.
newsitem.headline: Ottawa to cut red tape for small business.

text.p: The federal government is planning to cut the amount of paperwork small businesses with good filing records are required to complete.

Small businesses with perfect compliance records will only have to file payroll deductions on a quarterly rather than monthly basis, Canada's Finance Minister Paul Martin said as he presented his 1997 budget on Tuesday.
The change could affect up to 650,000 small businesses, the government said.
